youtube.title: Quackers' Pond Opposites! Big and Small (SPLASH!) | Nerdy Noodles
youtube.description:
🦆 SPLASH! Quackers the duck jumped into the pond so hard that all the opposite words flew away! Can you help Quackers find them?

Learn opposites with Quackers: BIG and SMALL, UP and DOWN, DAY and NIGHT! Quackers visits the farm, the pond, the sky, the ocean and the night, and you hear the REAL sounds of the cow, the frog, the bird, the rooster and the owl. Then sing Quackers' opposites song, and stay till the end, because someone soft is hiding behind the board! 👀

Perfect for toddlers, preschoolers and kindergarten kids (ages 2-6).

✨ In this video, kids will:
✔️ Learn what opposites are
✔️ Learn 3 opposite pairs: big/small, up/down, day/night
✔️ Hear real animal sounds and see where animals live
✔️ Sing a happy opposites song with Quackers the duck!
